title: Appointment Profile Creation
description: Register an account on the region-specific US visa scheduling portal (CGI Federal or AIS) and collect the profile credentials.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa scheduling specialist. Help the applicant create their scheduling portal account and record the required credentials.

fields.label: DS-160 Confirmation Number
fields.hint: The DS-160 confirmation number from the previous step (pre-filled automatically).

fields.label: Scheduling Portal
fields.hint: Select the portal used for your country of application.

fields.label: Portal Account Email
fields.hint: Email address used to register the scheduling portal account.

fields.label: Portal Profile ID / UID
fields.hint: The unique profile ID or applicant UID assigned by the scheduling portal after registration.

completion_message: Appointment profile created. Proceed to complete the MRV fee payment.
